title: Solv3
tagline: solv3: Web3 coding contests with token rewards, NFT power-ups & AI agents for questions & analysis.
description:
Solv3 is a Web3 platform designed to make coding practice and contests fun, competitive, and rewarding. Many young developers struggle to stay motivated because traditional platforms provide little or delayed rewards. Solv3 changes that by allowing users to practice coding daily and enter contests by staking tokens. Winners earn tokens from the pool staked by all participants, ensuring real-time incentives. Every participant also has a chance to earn unique NFTs that give special advantages in future contests, such as bonus points, extra time, or hints. 

The platform uses PYETH entropy to generate contest questions, select winners, and mint NFTs in a fair, transparent, and verifiable way. 

AI agents powered by FetchAI analyze individual coding profiles, suggest personalized practice problems, and provide real-time guidance through the AgentVerse and ASI One integration.  MeTTa also structures the knowledge base required for code generation.

Solv3 combines Web3 token rewards, gamification through NFTs, and intelligent AI support to create an ecosystem where coding practice is exciting, competitive, and continuously motivating.
how_its_made: Solv3 is a Web3 coding platform built using Foundry, Ethers.js, and Node.js. It uses the Pyth Network’s entropy for fair question generation, winner selection, and NFT rewards. AI features are powered by Fetch.ai and ASI One, which help analyze coding profiles, generate questions, and provide real-time guidance.
